rationale: Bound the runtime-composition catalog entry to an identity projection (search corpus deduplicated, no inline declarations/method schemas; full document unchanged and served via the entry's resource_read action). The base archive's other bytes are retained dirty-source content that no clean commit reproduces (e.g. dist/nativeExtensions.js predates its own src) and must not be rebuilt. compositionCatalog is safe to overlay from source because the base archive's copy is byte-identical to a clean build of the pre-patch source.
